problem: The ordered delivery authority is honor-system: skills instruct agents to check admission before implementing, but nothing mechanically prevents an agent that skips the check, and every skill restates the same state litany, which drifts.
appetite: One bounded slice: active-issue binding, database-composed prime block, two fail-open lifecycle hooks, plugin wiring, verification, and one deduplication pass over the skills.
smallest_slice: Deny pre-admission source edits and inject persisted gate state at session start, both computed from the existing database and shipped through the existing plugin.
non_goals: A blocking Stop hook or exit gate
success_signal: A clean session on a blocked issue is denied its first source edit with the exact active gate as the reason, while a bare repository with no binding sees no interference at all.
reversibility: Unregister the hooks from the plugin manifest; all new commands become inert conveniences and prior behavior returns exactly.

risks.risk: Mechanical gating traps an agent mid-session on files it legitimately needs.
risks.mitigation: Deny only repository source paths, always allow the state directory, and fail open on any error or missing binding.
